subject.title: test(plugins): cover filtered bundle MCP servers

question: Should maintainers clear the active ClawSweeper human-review pause and proceed with this docs/test-only bundle MCP coverage after mergeability is refreshed?
rationale: The patch review found no concrete code defect, but the active human-review pause and mergeability state are workflow decisions that automation should not override.

options.title: Clear And Land After Refresh
options.body: Refresh or rebase the PR against current main, clear the human-review pause, and let automerge continue if checks stay green.

options.title: Wait For Filter Naming Direction
options.body: Keep the pause until the open namespaced `toolFilter` issue and candidate PR settle whether the docs should describe raw-only or raw-plus-projected names.

options.title: Close As No Longer Needed
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide bundle MCP tool-filter docs and loader coverage should not land in core.
